legend: Yash is so excited to see his favorite K-Pop girl groups because they are all performing in his city today! Given that there are $$$N$$$ arenas (numbered $$$1$$$ to $$$N$$$) in his city and $$$M$$$ roads that connect them, Yash realizes that the distance between them is quite far. Each road is bidirectional. He wants to construct a graph with the same $$$N$$$ vertices with a minimum number of roads such that for any pair of vertices $$$u,v$$$, if their shortest distance was originally $$$d$$$, their shortest distance in this new graph is $$$\lceil \frac{d}{2} \rceil$$$. Please help him!

Note that $$$\lceil \frac{d}{2} \rceil$$$ is the smallest integer that is greater than or equal to $$$\frac{d}{2}$$$. For example, $$$\lceil \frac{1}{2}\rceil=1$$$, $$$\lceil \frac{2}{2}\rceil=1$$$, $$$\lceil \frac{3}{2}\rceil=2$$$, $$$\lceil \frac{4}{2}\rceil=2$$$, etc.
input: Each test contains multiple test cases.
The first line contains the number of test cases $$$t$$$ ($$$1≤t≤1000$$$). The description of each test case follows.
The first line contains two integers: $$$N$$$ ($$$1≤N≤1000$$$), the number of arenas, and $$$M$$$ ($$$1≤M≤1000$$$), the number of roads.
The next $$$M$$$ lines each contain two integers: $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$, describing the two arenas that a road connects.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$N$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2000$$$, and the sum of $$$M$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$10^{4}$$$.
output: For each test case, output the number of roads $$$R$$$ in the newly constructed graph.
In the next $$$R$$$ lines, output $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$, the two arenas that this road connects.
note: In the first test case, the new road list has $$$6$$$ roads among $$$N=4$$$ arenas.
In the second test case, the new road list has $$$5$$$ roads among $$$N=4$$$ arenas.
In the third test case, the new road list has $$$10$$$ roads among $$$N=6$$$ arenas.

All three graphs satisfy the distance-halving constraint; for example, in the second testcase, nodes $$$1$$$ and $$$4$$$ are distance $$$3$$$ in the original graph, but they are distance $$$\lceil \frac{3}{2} \rceil = 2$$$ in the outputted graph (via path $$$1 \rightarrow 2 \rightarrow 4$$$).
A road between $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$ may be printed as "$$$u\ v$$$" or "$$$v\ u$$$", and roads may be printed in any order; any listing that describes the same set of roads is accepted.

legend.ai: Yash 非常兴奋，因为他最喜欢的 K-Pop 女子组合今天都会在他的城市演出！已知他的城市有 $$$N$$$ 个场馆(编号从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$N$$$)，由 $$$M$$$ 条道路连接。Yash 意识到这些场馆之间的距离相当远。每条道路都是双向的。他想构造一个与原图有相同 $$$N$$$ 个顶点、且道路数量最少的图，使得对于任意一对顶点 $$$u,v$$$，如果它们在原图中的最短距离是 $$$d$$$，那么它们在新图中的最短距离就是 $$$\lceil \frac{d}{2} \rceil$$$。请帮帮他！

注意，$$$\lceil \frac{d}{2} \rceil$$$ 是大于或等于 $$$\frac{d}{2}$$$ 的最小整数。例如，$$$\lceil \frac{1}{2}\rceil=1$$$、$$$\lceil \frac{2}{2}\rceil=1$$$、$$$\lceil \frac{3}{2}\rceil=2$$$、$$$\lceil \frac{4}{2}\rceil=2$$$ 等。

input.ai: 每个测试包含多个测试用例。
第一行包含测试用例的数量 $$$t$$$($$$1≤t≤1000$$$)。接下来是每个测试用例的描述。
接下来的 $$$M$$$ 行中，每行包含两个整数：$$$u$$$ 和 $$$v$$$，表示一条道路连接的两个竞技场。
保证所有测试用例中 $$$N$$$ 的总和不超过 $$$2000$$$，且 $$$M$$$ 的总和不超过 $$$10^{4}$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出新构造图中的道路数量 $$$R$$$。
接下来 $$$R$$$ 行，输出 $$$u$$$ 和 $$$v$$$，即这条道路连接的两个竞技场。

note.ai: 在第一个测试用例中，$$$N=4$$$个竞技场之间的新道路列表包含$$$6$$$条道路。
在第二个测试用例中，新的道路列表包含 $$$5$$$ 条连接 $$$N=4$$$ 个竞技场的道路。
在第三个测试用例中，新的道路列表包含 $$$N=6$$$ 个竞技场之间的 $$$10$$$ 条道路。
这三个图都满足距离减半约束；例如，在第二个测试用例中，节点 $$$1$$$ 和 $$$4$$$ 在原图中的距离为 $$$3$$$，但在输出的图中它们之间的距离为 $$$\lceil \frac{3}{2} \rceil = 2$$$(通过路径 $$$1 \rightarrow 2 \rightarrow 4$$$)。
$$$u$$$ 与 $$$v$$$ 之间的道路可以打印为 "$$$u\ v$$$" 或 "$$$v\ u$$$"，道路可以按任意顺序打印；任何描述相同道路集合的列表都将被接受。
